To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the measurement of the electrical parameters (i.e. power and current RMS value) of an SSL product requires the use of a power meter, (ii) a power meter should be used in combination with a current sensor, (iii) the measurement uncertainty of the electrical parameters is strongly dependent on the DUT characteristics, (iv) the uncertainty can be calculated online using a calculation tool and (v) the uncertainty can reach up to 3.5% of the measurement result.
for the measurement of the electrical parameters, the uncertainty of the test equipment should be less than 2% for power measurements and less than 0.5% for current RMS.
the measurement uncertainty is a function of the device under tests (DUT) characteristics.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and validation of measurement procedures and the determination of uncertainty sources for the electrical parameters of SSL products, which is an essential part of the traceability chain.
the traceability of electrical measurements of SSL products.
the development of measurement procedures, the quantification of uncertainty and the development of an online calculation tool.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the uncertainty of electrical parameters of SSL products can be determined by using conventional measurement methods and equipment.
the uncertainty of the electrical measurement of SSL products is comparable to that of conventional lighting sources.
the uncertainty of electrical measurements for SSL products can be estimated with an accuracy of about 0.5% (1s, k=1) for power measurements and about 1% for current RMS measurements.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the uncertainty sources and their effects on the measurement uncertainty are identified and quantified.
the measurement uncertainty of SSL products depends on the characteristics of the test conditions and the DUT.
the measurement uncertainty of SSL products depends on the test equipment and the characteristics of the DUT.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is necessary to consider SSL products differently than conventional light bulbs, because the characteristics of the SSL products are significantly different.
the measurement uncertainty of the electrical parameters for SSL products is comparable to the conventional lighting sources, but that the uncertainty sources are different.
the uncertainty of electrical parameters can be reduced by a factor 5–10 if the test conditions and procedures are properly defined.
